capabilities.name: wc-loan-list-read
capabilities.description: Read the m_wc_loan list as returned by GET /working-capital-loans. The pinned capture holds one seeded loan (id 1, external id SEED-WC-L01, status active), so the read is exercised and its row is transcribed into a parity vector.
capabilities.evidence: Capture loans-list-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned {"content":[{... id 1, externalId SEED-WC-L01, status loanStatusType.active ...}],"totalElements":1} for the seeded working-capital loan. The list seam grades id, external_id and status (no money cell), and one parity vector is promoted from it.

capabilities.name: wc-loan-balance-read
capabilities.description: Read one working-capital loan by id (GET /working-capital-loans/{loanId}) and serialise its m_wc_loan_balance row as the response balance block: the thirteen stored columns plus the derived outstanding/due figures. The pinned capture now holds two captured facilities: the no-discount seed (id 1, external id SEED-WC-L01, status active, principal 1000.51, nothing repaid) and the discount-nonzero facility (id 2, external id OHWCCAP-DISCNONZERO-L01, status active, principal 1037.53, discount 37.53, nothing repaid). Both balance read-backs are exercised and transcribed into parity vectors.
capabilities.evidence: Capture wc-loan-detail-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned the balance block {"id":1,"principal":1000.51,"principalPaid":0.0,"principalAdjustment":0.0,"principalOutstanding":1000.51,"fee":0.0,"feePaid":0.0,"feeOutstanding":0.0,"penalty":0.0,"penaltyPaid":0.0,"penaltyOutstanding":0.0,"realizedIncomeFromDiscountFee":0.0,"unrealizedIncomeFromDiscountFee":0.0,"overpaymentAmount":0.0,"totalExpectedRepayment":1000.51,"totalRepayment":0.0,"totalOutstanding":1000.51,"totalDisbursement":0.0,"totalDiscountFee":0.0,"totalDiscountFeeAdjustment":0.0,"breachPastDueAmount":0.0} on loan externalId SEED-WC-L01. Capture wc-loan-discount-detail-raw.json (sha256 65e67678218eda58aa1536726c98ef0ddd88ca962556adfe5ecd260f88f967b9) returned, on loan externalId OHWCCAP-DISCNONZERO-L01, principal 1037.53, totalDiscountFee 37.53 and unrealizedIncomeFromDiscountFee 37.53 with every other balance column 0.0, the first non-zero totalDiscountFee in the corpus. The detail seam grades id, status and the balance money cells (stored and derived), and two parity vectors are promoted from it.

seams.name: working-capital-loans-list
seams.description: GET /working-capital-loans on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the m_wc_loan list (one seeded loan in the pinned capture).

seams.name: working-capital-loans-detail
seams.description: GET /working-capital-loans/{loanId} on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the per-loan balance read-back (two captured facilities in the pinned capture: the no-discount seed loan 1 and the discount-nonzero loan 2).

note: Working-capital parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Two capabilities are declared: the working-capital loan list read and the per-loan balance read, each exercised and transcribed into a parity vector. The breach-schedule and delinquency-range-schedule seams are NOT declared as exercised because no breach/delinquency range is configured on the seed and no write path has been captured to observe them; declaring them would be a fabricated observation.
